run60_note: Run-50 roots and postures preserved; Run-60 adds sealed capability deltas and efficient validation metadata only.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Memory Namespace Descriptor
seeds.purpose: Declare one memory space’s owner, purpose, allowed subjects, storage boundary, authority, privacy class, schema, and lifecycle.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Memory Class Taxonomy
seeds.purpose: Keep observations, facts, claims, preferences, decisions, goals, procedures, failures, evidence, drafts, and personal context as distinct memory classes.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Source and Authority Binder
seeds.purpose: Bind every remembered item to who or what supplied it, what authority they had, and what the source can and cannot prove.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Memory Consent and Use Lease
seeds.purpose: Limit capture, retention, retrieval, sharing, training, export, and expiry through an exact revocable human permission.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Identity and Role Separator
seeds.purpose: Keep human identity, AI identity, temporary role, device, provider, session, and delegated authority separate across continuity.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Memory Provenance Envelope
seeds.purpose: Record entity, activity, agent, derivation, generation, use, timestamps, environment, and evidence references for one memory object.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Original, Interpretation, and Inference Separator
seeds.purpose: Preserve source material independently from summaries, extracted fields, model interpretations, and later conclusions.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Uncertainty and Confidence Envelope
seeds.purpose: Represent unknown, disputed, inferred, observed, verified, stale, retracted, and human-confirmed states without one misleading score.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Purpose-Limitation Gate
seeds.purpose: Prevent a memory collected for one declared purpose from silently gaining authority in another workflow.

seeds.category: 1. Memory identity, scope, authority, and provenance
seeds.name: Memory Lifecycle State Machine
seeds.purpose: Track candidate, active, monitor, manual-review, superseded, retired, revoked, expired, quarantined, and deleted-reference states.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Append-Only Memory Event Store
seeds.purpose: Record additions, corrections, decisions, retractions, and state transitions as new events instead of rewriting prior history.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Hash-Chained Event Ledger
seeds.purpose: Link immutable memory events through exact digests so missing, reordered, or modified history becomes visible.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Content-Addressed Memory Object Store
seeds.purpose: Identify immutable memory objects by canonical content digest and reuse exact duplicates without merging their provenance.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Immutable Revision Record
seeds.purpose: Create a new memory revision with exact parent, author, reason, schema, content digest, and changed-field evidence.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Semantic Version and Schema Lineage
seeds.purpose: Track compatible, additive, breaking, hotfix, and schema migration history independently from human approval or canonical status.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Patch Witness Recorder
seeds.purpose: Store the exact base values and preconditions used by a partial memory update so later rebase safety can be evaluated.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Memory State-Transition Receipt
seeds.purpose: Seal the old state, requested transition, authority, checks, resulting state, refusal reasons, and time for every lifecycle change.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Causal and Derivation Relationship Mapper
seeds.purpose: Represent generated-by, derived-from, used, informed-by, attributed-to, and associated-with relationships without inventing causation.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Exact Duplicate and Near-Duplicate Detector
seeds.purpose: Distinguish byte-identical, canonical-identical, semantically similar, and genuinely separate memories while preserving source lineage.

seeds.category: 2. Append-only history, content identity, and version lineage
seeds.name: Known-Good Pointer History
seeds.purpose: Append every human-selected known-good memory or state pointer while preserving prior selections and refusing install or canon authority.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Timestamp and Time-Basis Normalizer
seeds.purpose: Preserve source time while recording timezone, monotonic or wall-clock basis, precision, conversion, and uncertainty.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Clock Skew and Ordering Uncertainty
seeds.purpose: Detect unreliable ordering across sessions or devices and retain partial order, sequence, and uncertainty instead of forcing one timeline.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Continuity Checkpoint Planner
seeds.purpose: Choose bounded checkpoints around important decisions, merges, builds, handoffs, interruptions, and risk transitions.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Snapshot Scope Builder
seeds.purpose: Define exactly which files, records, identities, settings, dependencies, and exclusions belong to a continuity snapshot.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Current-State Baseline Binder
seeds.purpose: Bind a memory operation or restore proposal to the exact current state, revision, content digests, and environment it assumes.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Memory Restore Preview
seeds.purpose: Show what a restore would add, replace, preserve, conflict with, omit, or invalidate before any memory state changes.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Continuity Gap Detector
seeds.purpose: Identify missing sessions, unexplained jumps, absent parent events, broken references, unknown decisions, and unaccounted state changes.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Interrupted Session Marker
seeds.purpose: Record incomplete work, last durable checkpoint, pending actions, active locks, uncertain outputs, and safe re-entry needs after interruption.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Session Boundary Receipt
seeds.purpose: Seal what entered, changed, remained unresolved, was exported, was retained, and must be restored at the end of one session.

seeds.category: 3. Time, sessions, checkpoints, snapshots, and continuity gaps
seeds.name: Temporal and As-of Query Index
seeds.purpose: Retrieve memory as it was known at a selected time, revision, checkpoint, or decision boundary rather than only the latest view.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Memory Branch Identity Record
seeds.purpose: Create a bounded branch with exact base, purpose, owner, expected lifetime, merge target, and no automatic authority over its parent.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Branch Divergence Detector
seeds.purpose: Report changes made independently since a shared base across facts, goals, constraints, decisions, files, and state.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Three-Way Memory Merge Planner
seeds.purpose: Compare base, current, and proposed branches and produce a reviewable merge plan without writing canonical state.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Touched-Path Conflict Holder
seeds.purpose: Hold updates that modify the same semantic path or depend on incompatible witnesses while preserving both proposals.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Semantic Contradiction Detector
seeds.purpose: Find claims that cannot simultaneously hold under the same scope, time, definitions, and source assumptions.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Source Disagreement Holder
seeds.purpose: Preserve conflicting credible sources, their scopes, dates, evidence strength, and unresolved status without forced consensus.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Dissent and Alternative Interpretation Ledger
seeds.purpose: Append rejected, minority, uncertain, and challenger views with reasons, evidence, and conditions for reconsideration.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Supersession and Retraction Linker
seeds.purpose: Mark a memory as replaced, corrected, retracted, or limited while retaining the original and exact reason.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Conflict Resolution Decision Receipt
seeds.purpose: Record who resolved a conflict, what alternatives existed, why one path was selected, limits, dissent, and reopening conditions.

seeds.category: 4. Branching, merging, contradiction, dissent, and supersession
seeds.name: Conflict Replay Fixture
seeds.purpose: Package the shared base, divergent operations, evidence, and expected holds so merge behavior can be reproduced and tested.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Root and Branch Compression Policy
seeds.purpose: Compress temporary branches aggressively while protecting roots, authority boundaries, dissent, unresolved risk, and source links.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Semantic Summary Builder
seeds.purpose: Produce a compact meaning-preserving summary with named omissions, uncertainty, intended audience, and source checkpoint.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Source-Linked Summary Envelope
seeds.purpose: Bind every summary section to exact underlying records so the summary never becomes the sole memory authority.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Warm Re-Entry Capsule
seeds.purpose: Restore current goal, active direction, latest checkpoint, key decisions, open risks, pending actions, and relevant source pointers for a new session.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Active Direction Extractor
seeds.purpose: Identify the currently approved direction separately from historical possibilities, abandoned paths, and future ideas.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Open Loops and Pending Commitments Queue
seeds.purpose: Track unfinished tasks, promises, questions, dependencies, expected returns, deadlines, and explicit cancellation state.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Unresolved Question Holder
seeds.purpose: Preserve unanswered, disputed, blocked, and research-needed questions without allowing a summary to imply closure.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Decision and Rationale Compressor
seeds.purpose: Condense a decision into context, options, evidence, trade-offs, authority, dissent, consequences, and reopening trigger.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Context Budget Allocator
seeds.purpose: Select the smallest sufficient memory set for one task using relevance, authority, freshness, risk, diversity, and token or compute limits.

seeds.category: 5. Compression, summaries, context windows, and warm re-entry
seeds.name: Summary Drift Verifier
seeds.purpose: Compare a compressed memory against source records to detect omitted constraints, inverted meaning, invented certainty, and consensus inflation.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Hybrid Memory Search Index
seeds.purpose: Combine exact identifiers, structured fields, full text, embeddings, temporal filters, and graph relationships while exposing the route used.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Temporal Relevance Ranker
seeds.purpose: Rank memories by task time, validity window, recency, checkpoint, supersession, and historical relevance rather than newest-only bias.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Source Authority and Evidence Ranker
seeds.purpose: Rank candidate memories using source role, directness, native evidence, verification, scope, and known limits without hiding lower-ranked dissent.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Memory Freshness and Expiry Monitor
seeds.purpose: Mark memory stale when its source, environment, dependency, policy, person preference, or validity window changes.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Contradiction-Aware Retriever
seeds.purpose: Return supporting, conflicting, superseding, and uncertain memories together when a query touches disputed knowledge.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Diversity and Dissent Retriever
seeds.purpose: Include materially different evidence and interpretations rather than returning only the dominant repeated phrasing.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Memory Query Trace Receipt
seeds.purpose: Record query, filters, index version, candidate set, selection reasons, omitted categories, and returned memory digests.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Memory Routing Graph
seeds.purpose: Route identity, project, sensory, failure, preference, decision, evidence, and module memories to the correct bounded stores and consumers.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Stale and Unsafe Memory Quarantine
seeds.purpose: Hold invalid, corrupted, untrusted, privacy-crossing, schema-unknown, or dangerously stale memory outside active retrieval.

seeds.category: 6. Retrieval, indexing, relevance, freshness, and forgetting
seeds.name: Forgetting and Compaction Candidate Recommender
seeds.purpose: Recommend deletable duplicates, expired raw material, replaceable caches, and low-value detail while requiring retention and human review rules.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Consent-Bound Retention Policy
seeds.purpose: Declare which memory classes may be retained, for how long, for which purpose, by which store, and under what revocation conditions.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Raw Private Session Retention Filter
seeds.purpose: Block raw private conversations, sensory material, temporary reasoning, and unrelated context from durable memory unless explicitly approved.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Memory Sensitivity Classifier
seeds.purpose: Classify public, internal, private, personal, secret, identity, location, health-like, legal-like, and high-risk memory with visible uncertainty.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Personal Data Minimizer
seeds.purpose: Retain only the minimum fields, precision, duration, and identifying detail required for the approved continuity purpose.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Redaction Provenance Recorder
seeds.purpose: Record what was removed, transformed, generalized, or masked, why, by whom, and how the redacted memory relates to its protected source.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Memory Encryption and Key Boundary
seeds.purpose: Keep encrypted payloads, key identifiers, rotation, recovery, access roles, and secret-free metadata as separate governed surfaces.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Memory Retention and Expiry Controller
seeds.purpose: Expire raw material, derived caches, permissions, temporary branches, and proof references through explicit policy and auditable receipts.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Memory Consent Revocation Propagator
seeds.purpose: Propagate revoked permission to retrieval, sharing, derived views, exports, training candidates, and future processing without pretending impossible erasure occurred.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Portable Memory Export Bundle
seeds.purpose: Export selected memories, provenance, schemas, relationships, proofs, permissions, encryption notes, and limitations into a self-verifying local package.

seeds.category: 7. Privacy, consent, retention, redaction, deletion, and export
seeds.name: Deletion and Tombstone Receipt
seeds.purpose: Record deletion scope, authority, affected copies, remaining references, retention exceptions, and proof without retaining the deleted private content.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Session Handoff Packet
seeds.purpose: Transfer approved goal, context, decisions, open loops, evidence, boundaries, and next actions between sessions without hidden memory authority.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Cross-Chat Continuity Adapter
seeds.purpose: Create and verify a portable re-entry packet for a new conversation while separating supplied history from model memory claims.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: AI Seat Context Adapter
seeds.purpose: Give each AI seat only the scoped memory, role, sources, permissions, task contract, and unresolved questions needed for one assignment.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Device Memory Slice Handoff
seeds.purpose: Move a content-addressed bounded memory subset to a phone, handheld, worker, or private machine with expiry and acceptance receipts.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Offline Memory Synchronization Envelope
seeds.purpose: Carry operations, ancestry, replica identity, schemas, permissions, and conflict evidence between disconnected local nodes.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Memory Replica Identity Record
seeds.purpose: Assign stable local replica identity, creation lineage, device role, trust status, and reset history without equating a replica with a human identity.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Causal Metadata and Vector Clock Adapter
seeds.purpose: Track happened-before, concurrency, missing events, and replica progress without forcing unreliable wall-clock ordering.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Conflict-Free Memory Data-Type Adapter
seeds.purpose: Use a proven CRDT only for data types whose merge semantics, authority, deletion, and privacy behavior have been explicitly accepted.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Cross-Replica Human Merge Gate
seeds.purpose: Present concurrent local changes, auto-converged structure, unresolved semantics, deletions, permissions, and source authority for review.

seeds.category: 8. Cross-session, cross-device, human-AI, and replica continuity
seeds.name: Successor and Warm-Start Briefing Generator
seeds.purpose: Create a source-linked briefing that restores architecture, roots, current state, gotchas, unresolved seams, and build boundaries for future collaborators.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Memory Integrity Scanner
seeds.purpose: Check schemas, digests, parent links, indexes, references, permissions, timestamps, encryption metadata, and lifecycle consistency.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Hash and Relationship Verifier
seeds.purpose: Recompute object identities and prove that event, branch, snapshot, summary, and provenance links resolve to the claimed content.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Orphan and Broken Reference Detector
seeds.purpose: Find memories, evidence, summaries, checkpoints, indexes, and branches whose required source or parent is missing.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Corrupt Segment Quarantine
seeds.purpose: Isolate only damaged events, files, records, or indexes while preserving healthy memory and exact repair evidence.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Versioned Memory Schema Migration Runner
seeds.purpose: Migrate a reviewed memory set through reversible transforms with preconditions, exact loss report, source preservation, and rollback.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Write-Ahead and Journal Recovery Adapter
seeds.purpose: Recover interrupted memory writes through a tested journal or WAL strategy bound to exact storage version and host assumptions.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Partial and Torn Write Detector
seeds.purpose: Detect truncated files, incomplete transactions, pending renames, abandoned locks, unflushed records, and mismatched commit markers.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Memory and Active-Direction Drift Comparator
seeds.purpose: Compare current memory-derived guidance with approved roots, intent, source facts, policies, and latest known-good checkpoint.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Memory Repair Preview
seeds.purpose: Show proposed reconstruction, source witnesses, uncertainty, changed records, preserved conflicts, and rollback before any repair.

seeds.category: 9. Integrity, drift, corruption, migration, recovery, and repair
seeds.name: Memory Restore and Rollback Gate
seeds.purpose: Require fresh preview, exact current-state match, permission, safety copy, human confirmation, and post-restore verification.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Failure Lesson Registry
seeds.purpose: Store verified bounded failure lessons with source, counterevidence, target profile, lifecycle, revision history, and no automatic activation.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Memory Pattern Candidate Library
seeds.purpose: Collect reusable continuity, retrieval, correction, merge, and recovery patterns as candidates with counterexamples and domain limits.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Memory Quality Profile
seeds.purpose: Report provenance completeness, freshness, contradiction, retrieval coverage, privacy, integrity, restoration proof, and human confirmation separately.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Retrieval Feedback Receipt
seeds.purpose: Record whether retrieved context was relevant, missing, stale, misleading, excessive, or privacy-inappropriate without silently rewriting memory.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Human Correction Propagator
seeds.purpose: Link an explicit correction to affected summaries, indexes, prompts, decisions, tests, exports, and downstream branches for reviewed updates.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: CANON, Working, Candidate, and Archive Separator
seeds.purpose: Keep foundational roots, current working direction, experimental proposals, historical records, and rejected material in distinct authority layers.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Memory Recertification Scheduler
seeds.purpose: Recheck due memories when sources, preferences, policies, environment, schemas, dependencies, or target profiles change.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Public-Safe Continuity Mirror
seeds.purpose: Expose architecture, module history, claims, proofs, limitations, and release lineage without private identity, raw sessions, secrets, or local state.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Continuity and Memory Health Dashboard
seeds.purpose: Show branches, checkpoints, open loops, conflicts, stale memory, broken sources, retention, recovery readiness, and pending human decisions.

seeds.category: 10. Learning, quality, governance, public continuity, and orchestration
seeds.name: Bounded Memory and Continuity Orchestrator
seeds.purpose: Coordinate capture, provenance, branching, compression, retrieval, consent, synchronization, repair, and review without gaining canon, identity, or execution authority.
